reuse.why: Reuses extractTagsFromText for tag parsing, but ignores the existing notes table (where group notes are stored by group id and served by notes/app.ts) and adds a new category_groups.notes column instead.

duplication.why: The tag rule is one predicate, isFixedGroup, but the same `g.notes AS group_notes` column and `if (isFixedGroup(...)) continue` guard are pasted into six separately copied category queries/loops.

placement.why: Introduces a schema migration and DbCategoryGroup field for data that already lives in the notes table, putting group notes in a second storage layer.

scope.why: Adds a migration and type change the request does not need, and makes unrelated whitespace edits to the banks and category_groups definitions in init.sql.

maintainability.why: A parallel notes column that nothing writes from the notes UI, plus a guard repeated in six actions, would confuse a maintainer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Reads group notes from a new category_groups.notes column instead of the existing notes table / notes app (notes-get), which is where group notes are saved.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated guard and column are verbatim, not disguised.

one_place.where: The #fixed rule is defined once in isFixedGroup in budget/actions.ts and every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) calls it, though each wires it in separately and reads the wrong notes source.
